objective: Build Phase 1 of Project Browser using Electron, TypeScript, React, and Vite
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Application starts cleanly on Windows with sensible window defaults (1280x800 min size enforced)
AC-2: Real external websites render inside a dedicated WebContentsView managed by main process
AC-3: Address bar navigation works with URL normalization (protocol inference, search engine fallback)
AC-4: Back, forward, and reload operate properly synchronized with webContents events
AC-5: Address bar updates on page navigation and redirects
AC-6: Loading states and navigation failures are handled gracefully without crash
AC-7: Window resize resizes WebContentsView without breaking toolbar or viewport layout
AC-8: Keyboard shortcuts operate correctly (Ctrl+L, Alt+Left, Alt+Right, Ctrl+R, F5)
AC-9: Security boundaries strictly enforced (nodeIntegration: false, contextIsolation: true, sandbox: true, no Electron APIs exposed to external sites, permission denial, window-open containment)
AC-10: TypeScript type checks pass with 0 errors and production build succeeds
AC-11: Clear README with architecture, setup, and security documentation
AC-12: Zero mock or unverified features claimed
non_goals: Bookmarks or persistent browsing history database
